entry.title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut Sets New Production Car Standards for 1/4-Mile and 1/2-Mile

media:group.media:title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut Sets New Production Car Standards for 1/4-Mile and 1/2-Mile
media:group.media:description:
On Sweden's National Day, June 6, the Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut delivered another historic performance at Koenigsegg's home airfield in Ängelholm, Sweden.
Piloted by factory test driver Markus Lundh and verified by Racelogic, the Jesko Absolut set new all-out production car top speed records for both the quarter-mile and half-mile, as well as new non-EV production car records for both distances' times - covering the quarter-mile in just 8.54 seconds at 305 km/h (190 mph), and the half-mile in 12.76 seconds at 373 km/h (232 mph).
Both top speeds are the fastest ever recorded for a production car.
This remarkable run also marks the first time in history that a production car has exceeded 300 km/h over the quarter-mile - and the Absolut did so with a healthy margin. All of this on an unprepped surface, on production car tires, and with power going to the rear wheels only.
The performance was made possible by new software advancements that will be rolled out via OTA update to the entire Absolut fleet.
Absolutely Remarkable!
Results: 1/4 mile: 8.54 seconds @ 305 km/h (190 mph) and 1/2 mile: 12.76 seconds @ 373 km/h (232 mph)
Recorded at Koenigsegg Test Track, Ängelholm, Sweden.
The run was verified using industry-standard www.vboxmotorsport.co.uk @vboxmotorsport (Racelogic) equipment and the recorded data was verified by Racelogic themselves.

media:group.media:title: KOENIGSEGG Sadair's Spear | Laguna Seca Lap Record
media:group.media:description:
Sadair's Spear sets a new lap record for homologated production cars at Laguna Seca!
The Koenigsegg Sadair’s Spear has established a new lap record for homologated production cars at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on November 4, 2025.
Despite a strict 90 dB noise limit on the day — a challenge met by fitting an additional, heavy muffler behind the rear of the Sadair’s Spear — factory test driver Markus Lundh achieved a blistering lap time of 1:24.16, verified by Racelogic.
With minimal time on track, this achievement highlights the outstanding performance of the Sadair’s Spear and Koenigsegg’s proven in-house engineering solutions — even while contending with the added pendulum weight of the auxiliary muffler mounted behind the car.

entry.title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut | 0-400-0 km/h - NEW WORLD RECORD

media:group.media:title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut | 0-400-0 km/h - NEW WORLD RECORD
media:group.media:description:
Koenigsegg has once again claimed the coveted 0–400–0 km/h world record for homologated road cars at Örebro airfield on August 7, 2025.
Factory test driver Markus Lundh piloted the Jesko Absolut to an astonishing new time of 25.21 seconds, surpassing both the company’s own previous benchmark from June 2024 and everyone else.
This latest achievement was made possible by new and improved software strategies applied to the same Jesko Absolut used in last year’s record run. Dubbed “Absolut Overdrive”, these refinements will be rolled out to customer cars, ensuring every Jesko Absolut owner benefits from the advancements made during Koenigsegg’s continued pursuit for technical excellence and software development.
“This run demonstrated the power of cross functional teamwork and exceptional communication between our in-house developed drivetrain systems,” said Christian von Koenigsegg, Founder and CEO. “It’s a testament to the synergies between our engineering & development teams, our cutting-edge software architecture, and avant garde class leading mechanical solutions.”

entry.title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut | 0-400-0 km/h - WORLD RECORD

media:group.media:title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko Absolut | 0-400-0 km/h - WORLD RECORD
media:group.media:description:
On Thursday, June 27th, 2024, at an airfield in Örebro, Sweden, a Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut driven by factory test driver, Markus Lundh, completed several new world records for a fully homologated production vehicle.
In one acceleration, from stand still, up to 412.72 km/h and back down again, the Jesko Absolut managed to take the following production car records:
0-400-0 km/h in 27.83 seconds. That's 0.98 seconds faster than the 28.81sec record for the same run set in 2023 by the Koenigsegg Regera at the same airfield. The Jesko Absolut's minimal downforce design (Cd of just 0.278) helped the car achieve the 0-400 km/h sprint section of the run in a mere 18.82 seconds (vs. 20.68s for Regera).
0-250-0 mph in 28.27 seconds. That´s 1.33 seconds faster than the Regera's 2023 record. The 0-250 mph sprint was achieved in 19.20 seconds.
The Jesko Absolut was driven in standard, as-delivered form except for a roll cage fitted for driver protection, plus a One:1 seat favoured by the driver. It was running on E85 fuel and shod with Michelin Cup2 R tires. Times were recorded and verified using industry-standard timing equipment from Racelogic with verification of the data by Racelogic Ltd HQ.

entry.title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko | Gotland Ring Lap Record

media:group.media:title: KOENIGSEGG Jesko | Gotland Ring Lap Record
media:group.media:description:
Curious about the Jesko Attack's track prowess?
To provide a glimpse into the level of performance, here's a lap of the Jesko Attack at Gotland Ring in September 2023. Gotland Ring is one of the longer tracks in Europe, at 7.3km. It has a number of jumps and undulations, presenting similar challenges to the even longer Nürburgring.
The ambient temperature was around 18°C, and the fuel used was pump gas with a 98-octane rating (EU – similar to 93-octane in the US). Test Driver Niklas Lilja mentioned that he pushed the Jesko to around 90% of its potential, as we were not there for records, but for vehicle testing and marketing activities.
The previous fastest published lap time that we've been able to find from Gotland Ring was 3:04.83, set with a Porsche GT3RS MR. The Jesko, in production spec, completed the same lap in 2:56.97. This time was recorded and verified by RaceLogic.
Enjoy, and stay tuned for more!
